about_the_game:
THE RISE OF THE ORDER

Thirteen years have passed since the events of Playtown and Playtown 2. The once-abandoned indoor playground has mysteriously reopened, and something sinister lurks beneath the surface. Determined to put an end to the enigmatic E.Y.E. Order, the protagonist infiltrates Playtown and soon realizes their suspicions were right. What was once a playground is now a front for something far more disturbing.

ENCOUNTER NEW FACES

The second wave of mascot creation has begun. As you explore the eerie new Playtown facility, it becomes clear that the scientists have taken things even further. They have designed new creatures, blending familiar mascot designs with horrifying mutations. Their purpose is to guard the hidden entrances to the E.Y.E. Order, ensuring no intruder gets close to the truth.

STOP HEXCOR BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE

A terrifying reality unfolds. Playtown is just the beginning. The E.Y.E. Order has expanded beneath California, with countless hidden facilities fueling their twisted experiments. At the center of it all is Hexcor, their leader, their mastermind, their god. He has set something catastrophic in motion, and if you don’t act fast, the consequences could be irreversible.

Uncover the truth. Survive the horrors. End the Order.

FEATURES

Uncover the dark secrets of Playtown 3 with a powerful new tool, the Crystal Remote, which lets you activate doors, bridges, and hidden mechanisms. Solve creative, one of a kind puzzles that challenge your wits as you navigate a decaying world crawling with intelligent mascots. These creatures don’t just follow patterns; they see, they hear, and they hunt. Use stealth to survive: stay quiet, stay out of sight, and keep moving. Every moment brings you closer to stopping the mysterious E.Y.E. Order before it’s too late.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 2 GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4790K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
